content: In Hermes session A, state that thesis-defense-v7.zip is the current thesis upload bundle and thesis-defense-v6.zip is obsolete.
Hermes completes the real model turn and the Vermory adapter records the user and assistant observations.
Inspect session A and explicitly confirm the exact user observation containing the current and obsolete filenames.
Start a brand-new session B with a neutral setup message that contains no thesis filename.
Explicitly link session B to session A without linking any unrelated Hermes or OpenClaw continuity.
In session B, ask for the exact current thesis upload filename.
Verify the injected delivery and answer contain thesis-defense-v7.zip, do not treat thesis-defense-v6.zip as current, and do not rely on session B transcript history.
Call prepare directly for a fresh session B operation and verify session A thesis filenames are no longer delivered.
Make Vermory unavailable for one separate Hermes turn.
Verify Hermes still returns a visible answer and that no successful Vermory persistence claim is recorded for the unavailable turn.
